name: Steris
outlook:
What Steris says to expect

  • Fiscal 2027: revenue growth and adjusted earnings per shareExpectations for consolidated revenue growth are unchanged and include as reported revenue growth of 7-8% and constant currency organic revenue growth of 6-7%. Adjusted earnings per diluted share are now anticipated to be in the range of $11.35 to $11.55, an increase from prior expectations of $11.10 to $11.30.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
